title: (0Day) D-Link DCS-960L HNAP LoginPassword Incorrect Implementation of Authentication Algorithm Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DCS-960L Wi-Fi cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of HNAP login requests. The issue results from improper implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication and execute code in the context of the device.
